news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a Healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital initiated Perimeter Medical Imaging AI as a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and a C$0.95 price target, citing the early commercial ramp of Claire. The report kept fellow imaging name Profound Medical as a Top Pick as well.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter, partnered with the University of Toronto, was selected among 10 projects for Canada's INOVAIT Pilot Fund to advance next-generation AI capabilities for Claire, with eligibility for roughly $148,000 from INOVAIT plus a $100,000 Mitacs award.

news.headline: Perimeter Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Perimeter reported Q1 2026 revenue of about $385,000 with 14% year-over-year growth in recurring S-Series OCT revenue and a 31% improvement in net loss to roughly $3.0 million, while flagging normalized revenue expected in Q2 as Claire's rollout begins.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes LIFE Offering
news.summary: Perimeter closed a financing of up to roughly C$14.42 million (LIFE Offering plus concurrent private placement), led by Paradigm Capital with heavy insider participation from CEO Adrian Mendes and Social Capital, to fund the U.S. commercial launch of Claire; the deal carries an embedded option to redomicile from British Columbia to the U.S. as a path toward a Nasdaq uplisting.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet reported Q2 2026 results as of Aug 10, 2026; the release should show early revenue traction from Claire's nationwide commercial launch and updated recurring S-Series sales trends.

catalysts.label: Claire commercial rollout / new hospital placements
catalysts.detail: Following March 2026 FDA PMA approval, Perimeter is executing a nationwide commercial launch of Claire; further hospital system placements and legacy S-Series-to-Claire conversions (building on the first two placements disclosed in Q1 2026) are a key revenue catalyst to watch.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. redomiciling and Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: The May 2026 LIFE Offering included convertible debentures that automatically convert if Perimeter continues from British Columbia to a U.S. jurisdiction, a mechanism explicitly structured to open a path to Nasdaq uplisting and QSBS-eligible securities.

pulse: Perimeter is in the early innings of commercializing Claire, the first FDA-approved AI-enabled OCT device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment (PMA approval March 2026), backed by a ~C$14.4 million May 2026 financing that also embeds an option to redomicile to the U.S. and pursue a Nasdaq uplisting. Q1 2026 revenue remained small (~$385K) but recurring legacy S-Series sales grew 14% year-over-year with narrowing losses, and recent news flow (a new Paradigm Capital Top Pick rating, a Canadian INOVAIT AI-development grant) points to steady analyst and non-dilutive funding support while investors await Q2 2026 results and further evidence of Claire's commercial ramp.
